purpose: Small reviewed teaching selection, not whole-catalog ground truth. Facts and source labels never influence retrieval scores.

cases.label: Find the listing
cases.title: Recover the headphones Alex saved.
cases.need: Alex has saved a Bose listing for calls and focused work. A transposed listing ID should not replace that specific product with a related item.

facts.label: Listening
facts.quote: Limited Edition, QC35 Series II, Noise Cancelling, Over Ear Headphones in Triple Midnight

facts.label: Microphone
facts.quote: Noise-rejecting dual-microphone system for clear sound and voice pick-up

products.assessment: The listing describes noise cancellation and a noise-rejecting microphone. The Lab 1 repair recovers this identity.
products.still_unknown: Advertised microphone features do not establish call quality in Alex’s room.

cases.label: Check the charging
cases.title: A USB-C port is only part of the answer.
cases.need: Alex wants space for code and documents and fewer cables. For this exercise, his stated charging requirement is up to 90W. That requirement is part of the scenario; his laptop’s compatibility still needs checking.

facts.label: Size
facts.quote: 27 Inches

facts.label: Connection
facts.quote: 1 HDMI 1.4; 1 HDMI 2.0; 1 DisplayPort 1.2 with versatile USB-C connectivity

products.assessment: 27-inch · 4K · USB-C. Charging wattage is not stated in this imported record.
products.still_unknown: Do not turn missing wattage into “does not charge” or assume it supplies 90W.

facts.label: Size
facts.quote: 27 Inches

facts.label: Resolution
facts.quote: 3840 x 2160 Pixels

facts.label: Charging
facts.quote: USB-C connectivity, get up to 90W of power delivery

products.assessment: 27-inch · 4K · Up to 90W stated. This documented option must reach reranking before it can be considered.
products.still_unknown: Confirm Alex’s laptop accepts USB-C power/video and the cable meets the required rating.

cases.label: Support the choice
cases.title: Adjustments are stated. All-day comfort is personal.
cases.need: Alex checks the monitor from Lab 2 and an adjustable chair on wheels, consistent with his room’s vision. Compare the stated adjustments; Lab 3 must attach each source to the product it supports.

facts.label: Lumbar support
facts.quote: Steelcase Gesture Task Chair: Wrapped Back - Platinum Metallic Frame/Base/Seagull Accent - Adjustable Lumbar Support - Roll Control Hard Floor Casters

facts.label: Arms
facts.quote: Arms move like a human arm which allows users to be supported in any position

products.assessment: The listing names adjustable lumbar support, movable arms and hard-floor casters. Its wheeled base is consistent with Alex’s room illustration; the illustration does not depict this exact product.
products.still_unknown: Specifications alone cannot establish all-day comfort for Alex; check fit and relevant review evidence.

cases.label: Product or accessory
cases.title: An adapter cannot replace the headphones.
cases.need: A request for USB-C headphones should distinguish the listening device from an adapter for headphones someone already owns. This is an optional product-type check.

cases.label: Check the connection
cases.title: A wider screen still needs the right connection.
cases.need: Alex explores an ultrawide screen for code and documents. Compare the screen and connection separately; a broadly relevant result may leave the connection unanswered.

cases.label: One screen or two
cases.title: Two screens need a stand built for both.
cases.need: Once Alex considers a second display for reference material, he wants both screens off the desk. Compare the stated screen count before checking fit. This is optional after the three labs.
requirements: Check VESA pattern, each screen’s weight and desk stability

facts.label: Screen count
facts.quote: Single LCD Monitor Desktop Mount / Stand, White Deluxe with Gas Spring for 1 Screen up to 27", Model STAND-V001W by VIVO

products.assessment: 1 screen. This single mount does not hold two screens.
products.still_unknown: Do not infer that buying extra parts creates a supported two-screen setup.

facts.label: Screen count and fit
facts.quote: Compatibility - Dual monitor mount fitting two screens 13” to 27” in size and 17.6 lbs in weight with 75x75mm or 100x100mm backside mounting holes. Includes cable management to keep cords clean and organized.

facts.label: Stability
facts.quote: Full Articulation - Adjustable arm offers 45° tilt, 180° swivel, 360° rotation, and height adjustment along the center pole. Monitor can be placed in portrait or landscape shape. Warning: Please do not pull monitor(s) too far forward or backward unless the stand is bolted down, as this will cause stability issues.

products.assessment: 2 screens, 13–27 inches; 17.6 lb capacity and 75/100 mm mounting holes stated.
products.still_unknown: Verify each monitor’s weight without its stand, mounting pattern and the stand’s stability warning before calling it compatible.
